services.name: Dental consultation
services.description: A full look at your teeth and gums, and a clear plan for what, if anything, needs doing.

services.name: Dental cleaning
services.description: Scaling and polishing to lift plaque and tartar that brushing at home can't reach.

services.name: Fillings (pasta)
services.description: Cavities cleaned out and sealed with tooth-coloured filling, so the tooth works and looks whole again.

services.name: Root canal therapy
services.description: Treats an infected or inflamed tooth from the inside, so you can keep it instead of losing it.

services.name: Jacket crowns
services.description: A cap that covers and protects a weak, broken or heavily filled tooth.

services.name: Tooth extraction
services.description: Removing a tooth that is too damaged or decayed to save.

services.name: Wisdom tooth extraction
services.description: Taking out wisdom teeth that are crowding, aching or coming in at an angle.

services.name: Braces
services.description: Brackets and wires that move teeth into line over time, for a straighter, even bite.

services.name: Dental implants
services.description: A fixed replacement for a missing tooth, anchored in the jaw like a natural root.

services.name: Dentures
services.description: Removable teeth made to fit your mouth, replacing several or all missing teeth.

services.name: Teeth whitening
services.description: Lightens stains and discolouration for a brighter shade of your own teeth.

services.name: Direct veneers
services.description: Tooth-coloured composite shaped onto the front of teeth to close gaps and reshape chips.
